## Stage 3: screen under our protocol (causal)

Cost layers per trade in index points: gross = bid prices; spread = real spread (long fills at bid + spread, short exits at ask); spread1t = spread + 0.25 pt slippage per fill; net = spread + swap (E1_SWAP snapshot, fixed points per night, Friday x3). Spread real from 01/12/2021; 12/2020-11/2021 and 26/10-06/11/2026 are ESTIMATES (nearest real month's hour-of-week profile).
